title: Jay Feely
intro:
Jay Feely (Republican Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Arizona's 1st Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Republican primary on July 21, 2026.
As of April 2026, Feely was a former NFL kicker and analyst.
